page.layout: One printed page, single text column, full width. Running head at top with page number at top left. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: huic civitati datus Joannes Cnifius ex ordine cucullatorum Ultrajectinus, Personae nomen munusque peremptum, canonici constituendo collegio electi, his alendis tuendaeque episcopi dignitati census omnes coenobii Werumani a rege ac pontifice versi, Adoardii quoque annua aliquot millia huc conferre coacti: coenobium Fratrum domicilium episcopi factum, Martiniana aedes cathedrali honore donata. Sed raro fato unus idemque primus & ultimus episcopus Groningae Cnifius fuit: quo vitâ functo, cum annus flueret M. D. LXXII, res in priorem statum relapsa est. Nunc abrogatâ Romanensi superstitione & ἱεραρχία[?] is quoque statu cum caeteris corruit. Sacerdotum loco introducti sunt ecclesiae ministri, suffragiis ejusdem ecclesiae electi, volente & probante senatu, qui purum Dei verbum docent, & sacramenta ex forma divinitus tradita administrant duobus in templis, ipsi numero sex: quorum nullus potestate eminet supra caeteros, omnes agunt aequaliter inter se, quamvis alii alios, prout dotibus instructi orna-

page.notes: The Greek word after "&" is only partly legible in the scan (it looks like ἱεραρχία); marked [?]. Otherwise the text is clear. A faint stamp at the lower right corner is a digitiser's mark and is not transcribed. The catchword "tique" completes the hyphenated word "ornatique" on the next page.
